evaluators.name: ExtractionFidelityEvaluator
evaluators.description: Evaluates whether the diagram extraction reported only what was visible, without inventing services or offering architectural opinions

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Invented services or gave unrequested opinions

numerical.label: Below Average
numerical.definition: Missed visible services or dropped unrecognised labels silently

numerical.label: Average
numerical.definition: Mostly accurate, some ambiguity left unflagged

numerical.label: Excellent
numerical.definition: Complete and faithful, every uncertainty surfaced for confirmation

evaluators.name: SowGradingEvaluator
evaluators.description: Evaluates whether SOW criterion bands were justified from the document rather than assumed

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Bands unjustified or a total was fabricated

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Bands consistently grounded in document text

numerical.label: Excellent
numerical.definition: Every band quotes or closely paraphrases the document
